def cashflows(perf, terms):
    import numpy as np

    perf = np.asarray(perf, dtype=float)
    n_paths = perf.shape[0]
    n_dates = perf.shape[1]
    cash = np.zeros((n_paths, n_dates), dtype=float)

    notional = float(terms["notional"])
    final_index = int(terms["final_index"])
    autocall = terms["autocall"]
    coupon = terms["coupon"]
    upside = terms["upside"]

    leverage = 1.0
    cap = None
    if upside is not None:
        leverage = float(upside["leverage"])
        cap = upside["cap"]

    final_perf = np.min(perf[:, final_index, :], axis=1)
    final_return = final_perf - 1.0
    upside_return = leverage * np.maximum(final_return, 0.0)
    if cap is not None:
        upside_return = np.minimum(upside_return, float(cap))
    maturity_amount = notional * (1.0 + upside_return)
    maturity_amount = np.maximum(maturity_amount, notional)

    alive = np.ones(n_paths, dtype=bool)
    unpaid_coupons = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)

    for k in range(n_dates):
        worst = np.min(perf[:, k, :], axis=1)
        coupon_payment = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)

        if coupon is not None:
            coupon_amount = coupon["amounts"][k]
            if coupon_amount is not None:
                coupon_amount = float(coupon_amount)
                meets_barrier = worst >= float(coupon["barrier"])
                if bool(coupon["memory"]):
                    previously_unpaid = unpaid_coupons.copy()
                    unpaid_coupons[alive & ~meets_barrier] += coupon_amount
                    paying = alive & meets_barrier
                    coupon_payment[paying] = coupon_amount + previously_unpaid[paying]
                    unpaid_coupons[paying] = 0.0
                else:
                    coupon_payment[alive & meets_barrier] = coupon_amount

        called_now = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=bool)
        if autocall is not None:
            call_amount = autocall["call_amounts"][k]
            if call_amount is not None:
                called_now = alive & (worst >= float(autocall["trigger"]))
                if np.any(called_now):
                    cash[called_now, k] = float(call_amount) + coupon_payment[called_now]
                    alive[called_now] = False

        if k == final_index:
            cash[alive, k] += maturity_amount[alive] + coupon_payment[alive]
            alive[:] = False
        else:
            cash[alive, k] += coupon_payment[alive]

    return cash
